Additional dependencies in SSVEP Studio Research 0.3.0

jsoncanonicalizer 1.0.0 and es6numberserializer 1.0.0
Upstream: https://github.com/cyberphone/json-canonicalization/tree/master/dotnet
Packages: https://www.nuget.org/packages/jsoncanonicalizer/1.0.0
          https://www.nuget.org/packages/es6numberserializer/1.0.0

Copyright 2018 Anders Rundgren
Copyright 2006-2019 WebPKI.org (http://webpki.org).
NumberToJson: Copyright 2006-2018 WebPKI.org (http://webpki.org).
Number serialization was ported from the Mozilla Rhino project by Anders Rundgren.

Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0. See Apache-2.0.txt.
The NuGet assemblies are used without modification. Studio adds strict JSON input
validation and specifies the effective fields to include in configuration hashes.

MNE, NumPy, SciPy, and Python rfc8785 are optional external QA dependencies;
they are not required by the desktop exporter and are not bundled in this release.
Their versions are pinned in tools/requirements-research-qa.txt.
